query: Perform a correlation test between the composite deprivation score (Column B) and the percentage of population affected by a certain deprivation factor (Column D) to determine the strength and significance of their relationship.
code:
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

composite_score = df.iloc[:, 1]
percentage_affected = df.iloc[:, 3]

corr, p_value = pearsonr(composite_score, percentage_affected)

print("Correlation Method: Pearson")
print(f"Correlation Coefficient: {corr}")
print(f"P-value: {p_value}")

query: Build a regression model to predict the aggregate measure of deprivation (Column J) based on the composite score (Column B) and the percentage of population affected by a certain deprivation factor (Column D).
code:
import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

X = df.iloc[:, [1, 3]]
X = sm.add_constant(X)
Y = df.iloc[:, 9]

model = sm.OLS(Y, X).fit()

print(model.summary())
